newsitem.title: USA: American Exploration wins 30 Gulf tracts.
newsitem.headline: American Exploration wins 30 Gulf tracts.

text.p: American Exploration Co said Thursday it was the successful bidder on 30 tracts in the Texas Gulf of Mexico lease sale with bids totalling $5.6 million.

"With yesterday's tracts, we will have approximately 49,100 net acres under lease in sallow waters offshore Texas on which we have identified over a dozen prospects to- date," American's chief executive Mark Andrews said in a statement.
The new tracts cover 20,840 acres in the Matagorda Island, Brazos and Galveston areas of the Gulf of Mexico. ((--New York Newsroom 212 859 1902))
